<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 420" width="500" height="420">
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="white"/>

  <g stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- Main loop: rectangle from (120, 80) to (380, 320) -->
    <!-- Top wire with resistor R -->
    <line x1="120" y1="80" x2="210" y2="80" />
    <!-- Resistor R box -->
    <rect x="210" y="68" width="80" height="24" fill="white" />
    <line x1="290" y1="80" x2="380" y2="80" />

    <!-- Right wire with thermistor T -->
    <line x1="380" y1="80" x2="380" y2="185" />
    <!-- Thermistor T symbol -->
    <rect x="368" y="185" width="24" height="60" fill="white" />
    <!-- Thermistor diagonal arrow -->
    <line x1="358" y1="255" x2="402" y2="185" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <polyline points="388,185 402,185 402,199" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="380" y1="245" x2="380" y2="320" />

    <!-- Bottom wire -->
    <line x1="380" y1="320" x2="120" y2="320" />

    <!-- Left wire with 12 V cell -->
    <line x1="120" y1="320" x2="120" y2="215" />
    <!-- Cell: long thin bar, short thick bar -->
    <line x1="104" y1="215" x2="136" y2="215" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="110" y1="205" x2="130" y2="205" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="104" y1="195" x2="136" y2="195" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="110" y1="185" x2="130" y2="185" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="120" y1="195" x2="120" y2="80" />

    <!-- Voltmeter branch across R -->
    <!-- Junction dots -->
    <circle cx="170" cy="80" r="3.5" fill="#000" />
    <circle cx="330" cy="80" r="3.5" fill="#000" />

    <line x1="170" y1="80" x2="170" y2="40" />
    <line x1="170" y1="40" x2="235" y2="40" />
    <!-- Voltmeter circle -->
    <circle cx="250" cy="40" r="18" fill="white" />
    <line x1="265" y1="40" x2="330" y2="40" />
    <line x1="330" y1="40" x2="330" y2="80" />
  </g>

  <!-- Labels -->
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000" text-anchor="middle">
    <!-- Voltmeter V -->
    <text x="250" y="46" font-style="italic">V</text>

    <!-- Resistor R -->
    <text x="250" y="60">R</text>

    <!-- Thermistor T -->
    <text x="415" y="222">T</text>

    <!-- Cell e.m.f. 12 V -->
    <text x="75" y="204" text-anchor="end">12 V</text>

    <!-- Caption -->
    <text x="250" y="375" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16">Fig. 2.1</text>
  </g>
</svg>
